title: 勃兰登堡协奏曲
creator: Johann Sebastian Bach
note: 六首大协奏曲风格各异，几乎穷尽了巴洛克协奏曲的形态可能，是管弦乐配器的教科书。
noteEn: Six concerti grossi of wildly varied scoring — a masterclass in Baroque orchestration.

title: 哥德堡变奏曲
creator: Johann Sebastian Bach
note: 一首咏叹调引出三十段变奏，单主题穷尽键盘技法与对位的宇宙。
noteEn: One aria spinning into thirty variations — a universe of counterpoint and keyboard technique.

title: 平均律钢琴曲集（第一卷）
creator: Johann Sebastian Bach
note: 二十四对前奏曲与赋格遍历全部大小调，确立了调性体系与复调钢琴的圣经。
noteEn: Twenty-four preludes and fugues in every key — the Old Testament of tonal counterpoint.

title: 四季
creator: Antonio Vivaldi
note: 四首小提琴协奏曲配十四行诗，鸟鸣、冰面与风暴被音符写实到几乎可以看见。
noteEn: Four violin concertos with sonnets — birdsong, ice and storms painted in literal tone.

title: 弥赛亚
creator: George Frideric Handel
note: 从诞生到复活的全本清唱剧，《哈利路亚》合唱让英王起立的传说流传至今。
noteEn: An oratorio from Nativity to Resurrection — the Hallelujah Chorus that made kings rise.

title: 第45交响曲「告别」
creator: Joseph Haydn
note: 末乐章乐手逐一吹灭蜡烛离席，向雇主暗示该给乐手们放假了。
noteEn: Players snuff out candles and leave one by one — a hint that the court should grant a holiday.

title: G大调弦乐小夜曲
creator: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
note: 四乐章如被压缩到极限的古典主义样本，小夜曲成了莫扎特最出圈的旋律之一。
noteEn: Four movements of concentrated Classicism — the serenade that made Mozart ubiquitous.

title: D小调安魂曲
creator: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
note: 未竟之作由学生续完，安魂弥撒成了莫扎特死亡的预写。
noteEn: Left unfinished, completed by a pupil — the Requiem as a prophecy of Mozart's own death.

title: C小调第五交响曲
creator: Ludwig van Beethoven
note: 三短一长的「命运动机」从第一小节统治到末乐章，是交响曲中最强的叙事弧。
noteEn: The four-note fate motif governs the whole symphony — Western music's most famous arc.

title: D小调第九交响曲「合唱」
creator: Ludwig van Beethoven
note: 首次把席勒《欢乐颂》唱进交响曲，人声与乐队在末乐章合流为乌托邦式的高潮。
noteEn: Schiller's Ode to Joy sung by chorus and orchestra — a utopian finale that changed the form.

title: 第14钢琴奏鸣曲「月光」
creator: Ludwig van Beethoven
note: 三连音琶音的第一乐章如夜曲，慢-中-快的不寻常结构预演了浪漫主义。
noteEn: The triplet arpeggios of the first movement read like a nocturne — an unusual slow-mid-fast shape.

title: 冬之旅
creator: Franz Schubert
note: 二十四首歌串起一个失恋者走向雪夜的旅程，艺术歌曲的心理深度由此确立。
noteEn: Twenty-four songs tracing a jilted wanderer's walk into the snow — the emotional summit of the Lied.

title: 第八交响曲「未完成」
creator: Franz Schubert
note: 只写完两个乐章却已自足，第一乐章的歌唱性主部是浪漫主义交响的曙光。
noteEn: Only two movements, yet complete in itself — its lyric first movement dawns the Romantic symphony.

title: E小调小提琴协奏曲
creator: Felix Mendelssohn
note: 独奏开头即直入主题、三乐章无间断衔接，甜美与炫技并存的协奏曲典范。
noteEn: The soloist enters with the theme at once and movements run on — sweetness and virtuosity fused.

title: G小调第一叙事曲
creator: Frédéric Chopin
note: 叙事曲体裁的奠基之作，复杂的和声与即兴般的展开让钢琴成为说故事的乐器。
noteEn: The genre's founding work — narrative drama smuggled into pianistic texture.

title: 童年情景
creator: Robert Schumann
note: 十三首钢琴小品回望童年，《梦幻曲》用简单到极致的和声制造无限温柔。
noteEn: Thirteen piano miniatures looking back at childhood; Traumerei's simple harmony is pure tenderness.

title: 匈牙利狂想曲第二号
creator: Franz Liszt
note: 慢板引子到弗里斯舞曲，吉普赛音阶与炫技跑动让这首作品成了动画配乐常客。
noteEn: Lassan to friska, Gypsy scales and bravura runs — a cartoon-score staple.

title: 特里斯坦与伊索尔德
creator: Richard Wagner
note: 前奏曲的和声迟迟不肯解决，被称「特里斯坦和弦」，直接松开调性的地基。
noteEn: The unresolved 'Tristan chord' loosens tonality's foundations — an erotic, endless prelude.

title: 安魂弥撒
creator: Giuseppe Verdi
note: 把歌剧的戏剧张力带进弥撒，《Dies irae》的铜管与合唱是末日的音响。
noteEn: Operatic drama inside the liturgy — the Dies irae's brass and chorus sound like Judgment Day.

title: 茶花女
creator: Giuseppe Verdi
note: 让交际花当女主角的写实歌剧，《饮酒歌》的轻快与第三幕的哀歌同样锋利。
noteEn: A courtesan heroine breaks operatic convention — brindisi sparkle and final-act elegy cut equally.

title: C小调第一交响曲
creator: Johannes Brahms
note: 被汉斯利克称「贝多芬第十」，终乐章主题与贝九呼应，是二十年磨一剑的答卷。
noteEn: Dubbed 'Beethoven's Tenth' — the finale nods to the Ninth in a two-decade-long answer.

title: 天鹅湖
creator: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky
note: 双簧管奏出的天鹅主题与黑天鹅的变奏，让芭蕾音乐第一次获得交响的深度。
noteEn: The oboe's swan theme and Odile's variations give ballet music symphonic weight.

title: 第六交响曲「悲怆」
creator: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky
note: 末乐章一反常规以慢板收束并渐弱至无声，九天之后作曲家离世。
noteEn: The finale breaks convention — a slow fade to nothing, days before the composer's death.

title: 降B小调第一钢琴协奏曲
en: Piano Concerto No. 1 in B-flat minor (Tchaikovsky)
creator: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky
note: 开篇圆号奏出辉煌主题，被作曲家称为「洪水般的浪漫主义」，是比赛舞台常客。
noteEn: The horn's opening fanfare floods with romance — a competition-stage warhorse.

title: 第九交响曲「自新大陆」
en: Symphony No. 9 in E minor 'From the New World' (Dvorak)
creator: Antonín Dvořák
note: 在美国写就的思乡之作，第二乐章英国管旋律被改编成《念故乡》。
noteEn: A homesick symphony written in America — the Largo's cor anglais melody became Goin' Home.

title: 天方夜谭
creator: Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov
note: 独奏小提琴代表王妃舍赫拉查德，用音画配器把一千零一夜讲成管弦乐。
noteEn: A solo violin voices Scheherazade herself — a thousand and one nights as orchestral color.

title: 第五交响曲
creator: Gustav Mahler
note: 从葬礼进行曲到终乐章回旋曲，著名的柔板曾被电影《魂断威尼斯》借用。
noteEn: Funeral march to rondo; the Adagietto became a film score for Death in Venice.

title: 大地之歌
creator: Gustav Mahler
note: 以唐诗德译入歌的交响声乐套曲，末乐章《告别》绵延近半小时。
noteEn: Tang poems in German sung over orchestra — the half-hour Farewell closes on solitude.

title: 月光
creator: Claude Debussy
note: 《贝加马斯克组曲》第三段，全音阶与踏板制造出水面浮光的印象派月色。
noteEn: The third movement of Suite bergamasque — whole tones and pedal paint Impressionist moonlight.

title: 波莱罗
creator: Maurice Ravel
note: 同一旋律在固定节奏上反复十八遍、只靠配器渐强，是一场渐变而非变奏的赌注。
noteEn: One tune repeated eighteen times over a fixed rhythm — crescendo by orchestration alone.

title: 春之祭
creator: Igor Stravinsky
note: 首演引发骚乱，不协和音与重音错位的原始主义把音乐史拦腰截断。
noteEn: Its premiere caused a riot — dissonance and displaced accents split music history in two.

title: 第五交响曲
creator: Dmitri Shostakovich
note: 在遭受批判后以「一个苏联艺术家对公正批评的答复」自述，末乐章在掌声与疑虑之间摇摆。
noteEn: A 'Soviet artist's reply to just criticism' — a finale torn between triumph and irony.

title: 第八弦乐四重奏
creator: Dmitri Shostakovich
note: 题献「纪念法西斯主义的受难者」，却在其中嵌入作曲家自己的签名动机DSCH。
noteEn: Dedicated to victims of fascism yet built on his own DSCH motto — a coded self-portrait.

title: 蓝色狂想曲
creator: George Gershwin
note: 爵士与古典的混血，开篇单簧管滑音成了二十世纪最著名的起手式之一。
noteEn: Jazz meets the concert hall — the opening clarinet glissando is a century-defining lick.

title: 阿巴拉契亚之春
creator: Aaron Copland
note: 为芭蕾而作，香客主题的变奏透出开阔的美国大地气质，是柯普兰「美式之声」的代表。
noteEn: Ballet score whose Shaker-tune variations breathe the American prairie — Copland's open sound.

title: 第三交响曲「悲痛之歌」
creator: Henryk Górecki
note: 三个慢乐章用波兰圣母祷文与集中营刻字，1992年的录音意外成为畅销奇迹。
noteEn: Three slow movements on Polish prayers and a prison-wall inscription — a 1992 chart surprise.

title: 十八位音乐家的音乐
creator: Steve Reich
note: 由11个和弦驱动整场约一小时的脉动，简约主义用最小材料造出最大推进感，莱希2007年获极地音乐奖。
noteEn: Eleven chords drive a pulsing hour — minimalism's fullest statement; Reich won the 2007 Polar Prize.

title: 海滩上的爱因斯坦
creator: Philip Glass
note: 与罗伯特·威尔逊合作的五小时歌剧，数字、字母与重复音型剥离了传统叙事。
noteEn: A five-hour opera with Robert Wilson — numbers, letters and repetition strip away narrative.

title: 哥德堡变奏曲（古尔德1955年录音）
creator: Glenn Gould
note: 22岁的古尔德用断奏与飞奔速度重定义巴赫，录音室成为演奏家的新舞台。
noteEn: A 22-year-old rethinks Bach in clipped, breakneck style — the studio as concert stage.

title: 梁祝小提琴协奏曲
creator: 何占豪 & 陈钢
note: 越剧音调入交响，小提琴与大提琴的「楼台会」把东方爱情悲剧写成单乐章协奏曲。
noteEn: Shaoxing opera inside a one-movement concerto — an Eastern love tragedy told by two instruments.

title: 黄河钢琴协奏曲
creator: 殷承宗等
note: 取材冼星海《黄河大合唱》，钢琴与乐队的对抗如黄河怒涛，是革命年代的音乐图腾。
noteEn: Drawn from the Yellow River Cantata — piano versus orchestra as a torrent of revolution.

title: 黄河大合唱
creator: 冼星海
note: 八乐章合唱套曲写于延安窑洞，《黄河颂》与《保卫黄河》成为民族抗战的号角。
noteEn: An eight-movement cantata written in a Yan'an cave — a rallying cry of national resistance.

title: 二泉映月
en: Erquan Yingyue (Moon Reflected on Second Spring)
creator: 华彦钧（阿炳）
note: 盲人艺术家阿炳的二胡曲，1950年抢救式录音后成为民族器乐的巅峰之作。
noteEn: Blind musician Abing's erhu piece, preserved in a 1950 field recording — the apex of Chinese solo strings.

title: 十一月的脚步
creator: Tōru Takemitsu
note: 为琵琶、尺八与管弦乐团而作，东方乐器与西方乐队的音色对话充满空间感。
noteEn: Biwa, shakuhachi and orchestra converse — Eastern timbres in a spacious Western frame.

title: 西区布鲁斯
creator: Louis Armstrong
note: 开场六小节小号华彩与结尾即兴，把爵士从合奏时代带到独奏天才的时代。
noteEn: Six opening bars of trumpet cadenza reset jazz — the soloist era begins.

title: 黑、棕与米色
creator: Duke Ellington
note: 三乐章的爵士长作首演于卡内基音乐厅，想「把美国黑人的历史写进音乐」。
noteEn: A three-movement jazz epic premiered at Carnegie Hall, telling African-American history in sound.

title: 纽波特现场
creator: Duke Ellington
note: 《渐弱与渐强之蓝》中长达六分多钟的萨克斯即兴让现场沸腾，爵士乐迎来复兴拐点。
noteEn: A six-minute saxophone solo on Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue ignites a career revival.

title: Ko-Ko
creator: Charlie Parker
note: 以不协和的前奏和极速的即兴奠定比波普语法，帕克在此彻底告别摇摆乐。
noteEn: Dissonant head and breakneck lines lock in bebop — swing is left behind for good.

title: 猪油
creator: Dizzy Gillespie
note: 与古巴康加鼓手查诺·波索共创，非洲古巴节奏正式进入爵士。
noteEn: Co-written with Cuban conguero Chano Pozo — Afro-Cuban rhythm enters jazz for good.

title: 璀璨角落
creator: Thelonious Monk
note: 标题曲的节奏角度刁钻到乐队录了25遍，蒙克的棱角在混乱中自成秩序。
noteEn: The title track's crooked angles took 25 takes — Monk's jagged logic orders the chaos.

title: 酷派的诞生
creator: Miles Davis
note: 九重奏的非典型编制与弱化颤音的吹奏，为冷爵士定下「以退为进」的美学。
noteEn: A nonet's mellow textures and vibrato-free playing define cool jazz as understatement.

title: 蓝色情调
creator: Miles Davis
note: 全调式即兴的杰作，《So What》的两音动机让爵士摆脱和弦变化的束缚。
noteEn: Modal jazz's defining statement — the two-note So What riff frees soloists from chord changes.

title: 寂静之路
creator: Miles Davis
note: 电子键盘与两把电吉他的绵长织体，预告了爵士摇滚的融合时代。
noteEn: Long electric textures from keyboards and two guitars — fusion's quiet dawn.

title: 泼妇之酿
creator: Miles Davis
note: 把录音室剪辑当作创作手段的电气化即兴，获得格莱美最佳爵士团体演奏。
noteEn: Electrified jamming edited into structure — it won the Grammy for Best Jazz Group Performance.

title: 蓝色列车
creator: John Coltrane
note: 硬波普的标准范本，同名曲的蓝调节奏与首句号角般的旋律辨识度极高。
noteEn: A hard-bop textbook — the title tune's blues line and fanfare head are instantly recognizable.

title: 大步流星
creator: John Coltrane
note: 同名曲的和声每两个小节就转调，被乐手当作即兴的「毕业考试」。
noteEn: The title tune changes key every two bars — the endurance test of jazz improvisation.

title: 至高无上的爱
creator: John Coltrane
note: 四乐章组曲是科川写给上帝的感恩献词，「Acknowledgement」里的四音动机贯穿全篇。
noteEn: A four-part suite of gratitude to God — the four-note motto of Acknowledgement binds it.

title: 暂停时间
creator: The Dave Brubeck Quartet
note: 《Take Five》的5/4拍成为爵士最出圈的节奏实验，封面几何画亦是经典。
noteEn: Take Five's 5/4 meter is jazz's most famous rhythmic gamble, wrapped in geometric art.

title: 明格斯，嗯
creator: Charles Mingus
note: 《Goodbye Pork Pie Hat》悼念莱斯特·扬，整张专辑是民权时代美国的声音侧写。
noteEn: Goodbye Pork Pie Hat mourns Lester Young — the album is a sonic profile of civil-rights America.

title: 黑圣人与罪妇
en: The Black Saint and the Sinner Lady
creator: Charles Mingus
note: 六乐章的大编制芭蕾式组曲，班卓琴与低音号让明格斯的野心近乎管弦乐。
noteEn: A six-movement ballet for a large ensemble — banjo and tuba push Mingus near orchestral scale.

title: 爵士乐未来的形状
en: The Shape of Jazz to Come
creator: Ornette Coleman
note: 无既定和声伴奏的自由即兴（Harmolodics），让爵士进入没有和弦图的开放空间。
noteEn: Free improvisation without preset changes — harmonolodics opens jazz to boundless space.

title: 自由爵士：集体即兴
creator: Ornette Coleman
note: 双四重奏分置左右声道，近40分钟不间断的集体即兴，为整个流派命名。
noteEn: Two quartets in separate stereo channels improvise for 40 minutes — the genre gets its name.

title: 村庄先锋周日现场
creator: Bill Evans Trio
note: 爵士钢琴三重奏的圣杯，贝斯手斯科特·拉法罗离世前四天的现场录音。
noteEn: The holy grail of piano trios — recorded four days before bassist Scott LaFaro died.

title: 别的什么
creator: Cannonball Adderley
note: 米尔斯·戴维斯以小号嘉宾身份助阵，《Autumn Leaves》与同名曲的慢板堪称教科书。
noteEn: Miles Davis guests on trumpet — Autumn Leaves and the title cut are studies in taste.

title: 呻吟
creator: Art Blakey & The Jazz Messengers
note: 鲍比·蒂蒙斯的灵魂蓝调主题让硬波普有了「教堂感」，鼓手的轰鸣定义Messengers之声。
noteEn: Bobby Timmons' gospel-tinged theme sanctifies hard bop — Blakey's drive defines the sound.

title: 萨克斯巨像
creator: Sonny Rollins
note: 《St. Thomas》的加勒比节奏与《You Don't Know What Love Is》的慢板，罗林斯的轮转即兴巅峰。
noteEn: Caribbean St. Thomas and a searching ballad — Rollins at his thematic-improv peak.

title: 盖茨与吉尔伯托
creator: Stan Getz & João Gilberto
note: 《The Girl from Ipanema》让巴萨诺瓦席卷全球，1965年获格莱美年度专辑。
noteEn: The Girl from Ipanema took bossa nova worldwide — the 1965 Album of the Year.

title: 艾拉在柏林
en: Ella in Berlin: Mack the Knife
creator: Ella Fitzgerald
note: 忘词后用即兴拟声唱完《Mack the Knife》，现场史上最著名的「救场」。
noteEn: Forgetting the lyrics, she scats her way through Mack the Knife — live jazz's greatest save.

title: 忧郁小女孩
creator: Nina Simone
note: 首张专辑里的《My Baby Just Cares for Me》几十年后被香水广告重新带红。
noteEn: Debut LP whose My Baby Just Cares for Me returned to fame decades later via an ad.

title: 奇异果实
creator: Billie Holiday
note: 把私刑受害者的尸体唱成「南方树上的奇异果实」，爵士最痛的反抗之声。
noteEn: Lynched bodies as 'strange fruit' on Southern trees — jazz's most searing protest.

title: 科隆音乐会
creator: Keith Jarrett
note: 在劣质钢琴上即兴出的抒情长河，史上最畅销的爵士钢琴独奏录音。
noteEn: An improvised lyric river on a substandard piano — the best-selling solo jazz piano record.

title: 处女航
creator: Herbie Hancock
note: 每首曲子都以海洋命名，调式与空灵和声让整张专辑像一张海图。
noteEn: Every tune named for the sea — modal washes that chart an ocean voyage.

title: 猎头者
creator: Herbie Hancock
note: 《Chameleon》的放克贝斯线与合成器，让爵士放克进入大众视野。
noteEn: Chameleon's funk bass and synths took jazz-funk to a mass audience.

title: 坏天气
creator: Weather Report
note: 《Birdland》的复合节奏与雅各布的电贝斯，融合爵士的旗舰专辑。
noteEn: Birdland's odd meters and Jaco's bass — the fusion flagship.

title: 轻如羽毛
creator: Chick Corea & Return to Forever
note: 《Spain》把弗拉门戈与爵士和声结合，是融合时代最轻盈优美的门面。
noteEn: Spain folds flamenco into jazz harmony — fusion's airiest, loveliest calling card.

title: 出去吃午饭
creator: Eric Dolphy
note: 低音单簧管与铁琴的奇异音色对话，前卫爵士中最具音色想象力的奇作。
noteEn: Bass clarinet and vibes in skewed dialogue — avant-garde jazz's most colorful mind.

title: 业报
creator: Pharoah Sanders
note: 《The Creator Has a Master Plan》32分钟的自由赞歌，精神爵士的顶点之一。
noteEn: A 32-minute free-jazz hymn — the summit of spiritual jazz.

title: 萨奇达南达之旅
creator: Alice Coltrane
note: 竖琴与印度坦布拉琴织成冥想之声，艾丽斯的音乐早已超越了「爵士」标签。
noteEn: Harp and tambura weave a meditative drone — music that outgrows the jazz label.

title: 太空即此地
creator: Sun Ra
note: 太阳神方舟拉的非洲未来主义宣言，电子琴与异域和声营造出宇宙剧场的错觉。
noteEn: Afrofuturism avant la lettre — synths and exotic harmonies stage an interstellar revue.

title: 闲暇时刻
creator: Grant Green
note: 同名曲的十二分钟慢板慵懒到极致，是灵魂爵士里被低估的宝藏。
noteEn: The twelve-minute title ballad lounges to perfection — soul jazz's hidden gem.

title: 黑电台
creator: Robert Glasper Experiment
note: 爵士三重奏请来嘻哈与R&B歌手，2013年获格莱美最佳R&B专辑。
noteEn: A jazz trio fronted by R&B and hip-hop guests — the 2013 Grammy for Best R&B Album.

title: 史诗
creator: Kamasi Washington
note: 三小时、17人的大编制，把科川式精神爵士带回2010年代的主流视野。
noteEn: Three hours, seventeen players — Coltrane-scale spiritual jazz restored to the mainstream.

title: 土地上的血
creator: Wynton Marsalis
note: 三小时清唱剧式的爵士长作，首部获普利策音乐奖的爵士作品。
noteEn: A three-hour jazz oratorio — the first jazz work to win the Pulitzer Prize for Music.

title: 罗伯特·约翰逊全集
creator: Robert Johnson
note: 1936-37年的29首录音合辑，1991年获格莱美最佳传统蓝调专辑，是三角洲蓝调的源头。
noteEn: Twenty-nine 1936-37 sides collected; a 1991 Grammy winner — the delta blues at its source.

title: 更猛
creator: Muddy Waters
note: 约翰尼·温特制作的电声蓝调回春之作，获1978年格莱美传统民谣类大奖。
noteEn: Johnny Winter-produced comeback electricity — the 1978 Grammy-winning Traditional Folk Album.

title: 皇宫剧院现场
creator: B.B. King
note: 单音式颤音吉他对着芝加哥观众全力释放，被公认为最佳现场蓝调录音之一；金2004年获极地音乐奖。
noteEn: Vibrato guitar at full fire before a Chicago crowd — one of the greatest live blues records; King won the 2004 Polar Prize.

title: 月光下呻吟
creator: Howlin' Wolf
note: 首张专辑收录《Smokestack Lightnin'》，沃夫沙哑的嚎叫定义了芝加哥蓝调的另一极。
noteEn: Debuting Smokestack Lightnin' — Howlin' Wolf's guttural howl defines the other pole of Chicago blues.

title: 疗愈者
creator: John Lee Hooker
note: 与桑塔纳等合作的回归之作，1990年获格莱美最佳传统蓝调录音。
noteEn: A comeback with Santana and guests — the 1990 Grammy for Best Traditional Blues Recording.

title: 没错，我有蓝调
en: Damn Right, I've Got the Blues
creator: Buddy Guy
note: 芝加哥传奇重出江湖，1992年获格莱美最佳当代蓝调专辑。
noteEn: A Chicago legend returns in form — the 1992 Grammy for Best Contemporary Blues Album.

title: 德州洪水
creator: Stevie Ray Vaughan & Double Trouble
note: 在蒙特勒现场救场后录制的首专，把布鲁斯摇滚带回吉他的中心。
noteEn: A debut recorded after a Montreux rescue — putting the guitar back at blues-rock's center.

title: 不插电
creator: Eric Clapton
note: 《Layla》被改成原声慢板，1993年包揽六项格莱美含年度专辑。
noteEn: An unplugged Layla reimagined — six Grammys in 1993, including Album of the Year.

title: 布鲁斯破坏者（与克莱普顿）
creator: John Mayall & The Bluesbreakers
note: 把芝加哥蓝调带回英国并催生「克莱普顿是上帝」涂鸦，英式布鲁斯摇滚由此发端。
noteEn: It imported Chicago blues to Britain and spawned 'Clapton is God' — British blues-rock begins.

title: 暴风雨般的星期一
en: Call It Stormy Monday (But Tuesday Is Just as Bad)
creator: T-Bone Walker
note: 电吉他在蓝调中的奠基之作，推弦与爵士式独奏影响了整整一代吉他手。
noteEn: Electric guitar blues at its root — bends and jazz lines that shaped a generation of pickers.

title: 扫掉灰尘
creator: Elmore James
note: 把罗伯特·约翰逊的《I Believe I'll Dust My Broom》电声化，滑棒吉他的「啸叫」在此定格。
noteEn: Electrifying Robert Johnson's song — the slide-guitar wail that became Elmore James' signature.

title: 生于坏兆头
creator: Albert King
note: 同名曲的连奏与标题成了布鲁斯文化梗，是电声蓝调后期的代表作。
noteEn: The title riff and phrase became blues shorthand — late-period electric blues at its peak.

title: 每天都发生怪事
creator: Sister Rosetta Tharpe
note: 把福音与布吉乌吉钢琴合成一体，常被视为摇滚乐的最早萌芽之一。
noteEn: Gospel swing with boogie piano — often cited as a seed of rock and roll.

title: 机场音乐
creator: Brian Eno
note: 用循环磁带拼出可忽略的音乐，环境音乐一词与美学就此定义。
noteEn: Music designed to be ignorable, built from tape loops — ambient music gets its name and method.

title: 镜之高地
creator: Harold Budd & Brian Eno
note: 钢琴与电子延音的极简对话，像雨后山谷里的回响。
noteEn: Minimal piano over electronic sustain — an echo in a rain-washed valley.

title: 吉诺佩蒂
creator: Erik Satie
note: 三首裸体舞曲的疏离和声为「背景音乐」开了先河，被视为氛围音乐的精神始祖。
noteEn: Three detached piano dances that prefigure background music — ambient's spiritual ancestor.

title: 丝绸之路
creator: 喜多郎
note: 为NHK纪录片所作，合成器描摹驼铃与沙漠，是日本新世纪音乐走向世界的名片。
noteEn: Synthesizers evoke caravans and dunes for an NHK series — Japanese New Age goes global.

title: 烈火战车
creator: Vangelis
note: 合成器主题与慢镜头奔跑绑定，1982年获奥斯卡最佳原创配乐。
noteEn: The synth theme IS the slow-motion run — winner of the 1982 Academy Award for Best Score.

title: 水印
creator: Enya
note: 《Orinoco Flow》的多轨人声叠出空灵圣所，让新世纪音乐登上排行榜。
noteEn: Orinoco Flow's layered vocals built a cathedral of air — New Age on the pop charts.

title: 深林
creator: Deep Forest
note: 把喀麦隆俾格米人采样放进电子节拍，1995年获格莱美最佳世界音乐专辑。
noteEn: Cameroonian Pygmy samples inside dance beats — the 1995 Grammy for Best World Music Album.

title: 精选环境作品85-92
creator: Aphex Twin
note: 卧室制作的旋律化电子氛围，让「IDM」这个概念应运而生。
noteEn: Bedroom-built melodic electronica that coined a scene's sound — the IDM urtext.

title: 第四世界卷一：可能的音乐
creator: Jon Hassell & Brian Eno
note: 小号的「第四世界」理论——把世界各地的素材融化进数字延迟的雾中。
noteEn: Trumpet through digital delay — 'Fourth World' music, global sources in a haze.

title: 消解循环
creator: William Basinski
note: 一盘正在氧化老化的磁带循环逐渐剥落，被听作911事件当天的悼亡。
noteEn: A decaying tape loop slowly disintegrates — heard as an elegy for 9/11.

title: 衰败的精致化
en: And Their Refinement of the Decline
creator: Stars of the Lid
note: 弦乐与管风琴的慢速长音，把睡眠与聆听的边界磨得几乎消失。
noteEn: Slow strings and organ drones blur the line between listening and sleep.

title: 异步
creator: Ryuichi Sakamoto
note: 坂本龙一癌症康复后的声响日记，钢琴与故障噪音并置出生命感。
noteEn: Sakamoto's sonic diary after cancer — piano and glitch set side by side, vividly alive.

title: 睡眠
creator: Max Richter
note: 八小时、31段的「摇篮曲」，按睡眠节律设计，是夜晚真正的配乐。
noteEn: An eight-hour, 31-movement lullaby built to sleep through — music for the night.

title: 一个早晨
creator: Ludovico Einaudi
note: 极简钢琴与弦乐的小品集，同名曲因《无法触碰》电影成为大众入口。
noteEn: Minimal piano miniatures; the title piece reached millions via the film The Intouchables.
